# Isaiah Chapter 41 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 29 verses]*

*Cyrus from the east; Israel as servant chosen; idol-makers mocked; God holds your right hand*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God. This chapter cyrus from the east.

*-- LOGOS*
